architecture_upgrade: CCCXXVIII gave the beta numerator.  CCCXXIX integrates it exactly.  The cross-ratio R(y) linearizes the finite RG flow, and sqrt(5049) is the canonical W33 RG-time eigenvalue.

honesty_boundary: This is an exact finite RG-like flow in the inverse-scale coordinate.  A physical RG interpretation still requires identifying t and y with continuum energy, length, or coupling variables.
theorem: The canonical finite beta flow dy/dt=67y+140-y^2 integrates exactly under R(y)=(y-y_-)/(y_+-y), with d log R/dt=sqrt(5049).  Thus the W33 action architecture contains an explicit finite RG renderer before continuum units are assigned.
title: Integrated Finite RG Flow Compiler
